intelligence.essence: One button on the cover, and it says ENTER. The build showed two — "Begin the visual story" / "Read the agreement" — he said one. ENTER, pulsating, lit up, calling attention, because we want them to press it. The buttons come from the Hub — Collective, Personal, Activity, the great ones with icons in them — small and nice at the bottom, never big and huge, never flat inventions. No bottom bar at all, no slide count anywhere, no name on the way in. The bar folds away after five seconds so the whole presentation is in view. The headline font reads easily; the label is just NAYA; her picture is new on every slide.
